targets.note: created entries only; the seeded Eldoria book has 4 entries and is excluded from `achieved`

uiCreated.source: manifest.counts minus manifest.seeded (the pinned fresh-install baseline is measured, not assumed)
uiCreated.note: every resource here was produced by a real UI control or by the frontend module function behind that control; the input files the controls consumed are listed under generatedStressOnly

uiInteracted.source: round reports: one recorded step per real control interaction

productNativeSave.source: a20-corpus-provenance.mjs: derived from the persisted JSONL bytes (markers), not from a builder log
productNativeSave.method: derived from the persisted JSONL bytes: product-save-path marker, UI-turn marker (user + the assistant reply directly following it), and the remaining assistant messages the product writes when its New Chat function creates a chat with the character greeting.

disclosedCounts.uiTurnMessages: 5 real sends through #send_textarea/#send_but (the bounded sample); each successful turn persists 2 messages
disclosedCounts.productSavePathMessages: appended to the page chat model and persisted by the product own saveChatConditional; NOT UI turns
disclosedCounts.productNativeChatMessages: the character greeting(s) written by the product when a chat is created; NOT a send and NOT a save-path fill

manifestCrossCheck.basis: persisted chat+group-chat JSONL user+assistant records; the product-save-path share is disclosed by the run that produced it

productNativeSave.note: messages appended to the page chat model and persisted through the product own save (saveChatConditional) are NOT UI turns; they are disclosed separately and were never hand-written JSONL

generatedStressOnly.source: driver-generated input files consumed by UI import controls
generatedStressOnly.note: cards (PNG), world books (JSON), presets (JSON), backgrounds/themes; they are inputs, never counted as created product resources

chatCreation.source: fill action log + manifest chat count
chatCreation.attribution: UI-control-created and product-function-created chats are recorded separately; the disk count is the sum measured by the manifest, and the difference between the recorded actions and the disk count is NOT attributed to a behaviour this probe instrumented (a New Chat call can also persist the outgoing chat), so it is disclosed as a boundary.

determinism.replay: the driver skips resources that already exist, so a re-run over the same tree is an idempotent replay; a fresh tier run starts from a fresh data root and the manifest digest pins the result

honestLimits: A generated input file is not a user artefact; only the UI import action is the creation provenance for cards/books/presets.
The message split is disclosed, not hidden: the product-save-path share is not UI-originated.
A tier matrix is a corpus, not a real human long-lived directory (GOAL.md section 14 stays NOT MET).
Counts are computed from the finalized tree, never copied from a builder log.
